# The kind of surface each of this game's terrain and tie textures shows (PLAN 9.2), for its Rift Apart material: stem kind,
# kind one of sand, rock, metal, panel, grass, floor, wood, ice, plant, other. Every texture of every story level's world
# (scripts/surfaces-measure.ps1 lists each level's whole world, not only what its gameplay picture shows: 4,581 textures).
# The kind picks the material (scripts/riftapart-pair.py, textures/riftapart-shortlist.txt) whose albedo replaces the
# texture's colour, moved to its mean colour, with its relief and gloss (a plant keeps its painted leaves and takes the
# material's grain): sand loose ground and earthy strata; rock natural rock, cliffs, rocky strata, masonry, cobbles; grass
# grass and moss as a surface; floor concrete, plaster, asphalt, paving, tiles; metal plain or worn metal without a panel
# layout; panel this game's designed sci-fi plates (seams, trims, rivets, vents, grates, machinery), which take Rift Apart's
# own panels; wood planks, beams, bark; ice ice and snow; plant leaf and foliage cut-outs. other keeps its texture as it is:
# lights, glows, screens, windows, signs, text, emblems, photos, glass, water, lava, energy, sky, smooth gradients, painted
# patterns; and without looking, every texture of the vid-comic levels only (30 to 36: their pixel and comic art is their
# look) and every texture whose coordinates span no area (no repeat to tile a material by).
# Judged 15 November 2026 from contact sheets by four labelling passes and a second review pass by kind (241 corrections:
# lights and screens taken for panels, plain metal and stone left as other, cliffs taken for sand), the player's call.
# Read by scripts/uya-surfaces.py, which stops naming any texture without a kind here.
